minos.before: navmesh/adv_foreas_concordia_divide_minoscaverns.nav sha256 e23249aecb15a7433d9981b31b04f3bb5c68200f0b82f076dd562a2a81f8d74d: 1,426 polygons; islands of 745 (the Bane base and upper tunnels, x -27..312), 199 (Tyler's canyon, y -31..-1), 98 (the sealed control room), 53, 45 (the entrance and medic, z 63..125), 43, 24 (Horlo's branch, x -58..-32) and 20 smaller
minos.cause: The map has no terrain archive (0 terrain triangles): the cave is laid from cavern tiles (TerraTunnel* classes 2625-2834) on an 8/16/24 m grid. At the joints their collision floors overlap. At -2, 24, 61 (TerraTunnelStraight21Ramp7 2829 at -2,26,56 meeting TerraTunnelStraight21 2631 at -2,34,104) the column through the geometry reads: a downward face at 23.05, the ramp's floor at 23.6-24.0, the next tile's floor at 24.3-25.4, the ceiling at 30.1-31. Under the upper floor the ramp's has less than the 2 m agent height; the upper floor is 1.1-1.5 m above the ramp's last row except across x -2.5..-0.5, where it is 0.46 m. That strip, about 2 m wide, is the walkway, and the 0.6 m agent radius (two whole 0.4 m cells a side) eroded it away; the Horlo branch joint (-30, 27.4, 22) is the same shape. Terrain cuts cannot apply: there is no terrain.
